targets.expr: sum by (openclaw_provider, openclaw_model, openclaw_token, openclaw_agent, openclaw_channel) (increase(openclaw_tokens_total{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id",openclaw_provider=~"$provider",openclaw_model=~"$model"}[$__range]))

sum by (openclaw_provider, openclaw_model, openclaw_api, openclaw_transport, openclaw_error_category, openclaw_failure_kind) (increase(openclaw_model_call_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id",openclaw_provider=~"$provider",openclaw_model=~"$model",openclaw_error_category=~".+"}[$__range]))

sum by (openclaw_provider, openclaw_model, openclaw_failover_to_provider, openclaw_failover_to_model, openclaw_failover_reason, openclaw_failover_suspended, openclaw_lane) (increase(openclaw_model_failover_total{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id"}[$__range]))

sum by (openclaw_state, openclaw_action, openclaw_active_work_kind, openclaw_status, openclaw_reason) (increase(openclaw_session_recovery_completed_total{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id"}[$__range]))

sum by (openclaw_harness_id, openclaw_harness_plugin, openclaw_provider, openclaw_model, openclaw_outcome) (rate(openclaw_harness_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id",openclaw_provider=~"$provider",openclaw_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, openclaw_harness_id, openclaw_provider, openclaw_model) (rate(openclaw_harness_duration_ms_milliseconds_bucket{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id",openclaw_provider=~"$provider",openclaw_model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (gen_ai_tool_name, openclaw_tool_name, openclaw_tool_source, openclaw_tool_owner, openclaw_error_category) (increase(openclaw_tool_execution_duration_ms_milliseconds_count{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id"}[$__range]))

sum by (gen_ai_tool_name, openclaw_tool_name, openclaw_tool_source, openclaw_tool_owner, openclaw_denied_reason) (increase(openclaw_tool_execution_blocked_total{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id"}[$__range]))

sum by (openclaw_skill_name, openclaw_skill_source, openclaw_skill_activation, openclaw_agent, openclaw_tool_name) (increase(openclaw_skill_used_total{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id"}[$__range]))

sum by (openclaw_exporter, openclaw_signal, openclaw_status, openclaw_reason, openclaw_error_category) (increase(openclaw_telemetry_exporter_events_total{job="openclaw-gateway",gateway_id=~"$gateway_id"}[$__range]))
